prompt:
Create an original production RTS game SPRITE ATLAS, transparent PNG, 1536x2560 canvas. EXACTLY fifteen complete town-center building sprites in a 3-column by 5-row grid, each512x512cell. No captions or lines. Semi-realistic painted historical architecture with very detailed roof tiles, weathered plaster and masonry, wood joints and textile folds. Upper-left daylight, all vertical walls perfectly vertical.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: Every building has a thin flat SQUARE ground foundation projected as a PERFECT SYMMETRIC 2:1 DIAMOND, width320px, height160px. Within eachcell, floor vertices are top=(256,304), right=(416,384), bottom=(256,464), left=(96,384). Left/right corners MUST share exactlythe sameY, top/bottom exactlythe sameX. The camera is orthographic 45degree azimuth, 30degree elevation, equal projection along bothX/Yworldaxes. Left and right visible walls have ground/roof edges at equal and opposite slopes plus/minus0.5. NOT perspective, NOT 3/4oblique camera, NOT widefrontface with narrow sideface, NOT rotated or skewed rectangle. The square foundation remains visibly perfect with equally long diamond sides under every sprite. Building centeredonplatform, any stair inside thediamond perimeter, nothing protrudes beyond its corners. Literal bottomcorner clearly visible centeredat x256. Shape is square in worldcoordinates, never a longrectangle. No tall platform blocks or thick terrainislands. Keep enoughmarginabove roofs andbetween cells.
Rows top-to-bottom:
1 ROMAN: ageI modest warmplaster hallwith redterracotta gabledroof and woodenporch; ageII pale-limestone civic hallwith redtileroof, equal-width sidewalls and frontcolumns; ageIII richRoman columnedhall with layeredtileroofs, laurel/redcloth accents. Keepall architecture compactonits squarefoundation.
2 MONGOL: ageI circular creamfelt yurtwith a blueband and woodenentry; ageII improvedlarge yurtwith richer timberdoorframe and blue cloth; ageIII impressive butcompact yurtwith goldfinial and bluegoldembroidery, all on square stonefloor, no flagpolesaroundit.
3 PERSIAN: ageI warmadobe flatroofedhall with simple woodporch; ageII carvedlimestone flatroof civic hallwith turquoiseceramic bands; ageIII ornate goldturquoise limestonehall withfrontcolumnsand smallsculptedliondetails insideits squarefloor.
4 TANG CHINESE: ageI modest redbrowntimberhall with curveddarkgreytile roofand ivorypanels; ageII larger redwoodhall with deeperbrackets and goldtrim; ageIII grandtwo-tier compacthallwith curveddarkroofs, redpillars and stonestairs.
5 OTTOMAN: ageI plasterandtimber civic housewith orange terracotta roof; ageII compact limestonearcade hallwithtiles and smalltealdome; ageIII majestic limestonehall with centraltealdome and tiledsidewings, allwithin same320x160squarefloor.
Columns lefttoright: ageI, ageII, ageIII. Every cell contains ONEbuildingand its matchingfootprint. Agedevelopment addsdetail/tallness butall15use sameexactworldsquarefootprint andexactcamera. Architecturaldifferencesmust be clear, realisticand original. Buildingsread asrealistic RTSsprites,notUIicons, notcartoons/flatvectors, notplastic3Drenders. No people, animals, forests, scenes, sceneryoutsidefoundation, labels/text/numbers, watermark, logos, gridlines or opaquebackground. TRUEtransparent alpha everywhereoutside individualbuilding/foundation silhouettes.
references: None included in final generation. Architecture was specified in the original prompt; source v2 and three secondary-building atlases were inspected for style and geometry.

sourceCorrection.problem: V2 had rectangular, oblique ground platforms with front corners up to approximately60 source px away from side-corner center, inconsistent with a square 4x4 game footprint.
sourceCorrection.resolution: New artwork has a square world foundation and symmetric isometric camera. Renderer preserves vertical columns with independent axis scale; there is no whole-image horizontal or vertical shear.
sourceCorrection.measurement: Read-only opaque alpha contour; threshold180; side corner medians sampled over5px; front median over deepest contour±2px. Foundation fitted through side-height midpoint and central front axis; fitting errors<=2sourcepx.

rejectedTrials.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: corrected ORIGINAL isometric RTS town-center atlas with true transparent alpha, intended for a fixed 2:1 isometric game grid.
Reference images: Image 1 is the existing town-center atlas: preserve its FIVE civilization identities and THREE distinct ages, its detailed realistic materials and architecture. Images 2-4 are the game's other buildings: match their camera angle, daylight, fine natural painterly sprite material. Image 5 is STRICT GEOMETRY ONLY: fifteen perfectly symmetric SQUARE ground footprints projected into identical 2:1 diamonds. Its colors/guide lines are NOT final art.
Create a NEW high resolution 1536x2560 transparent PNG atlas, 3 columns by 5 rows, exactly 15 fully detached complete town-center buildings. Row order top to bottom Roman, Mongol, Persian, Tang Chinese, Ottoman. Column order age I, age II, age III. Align each sprite with the corresponding diamond of Image 5. Within each 512x512 cell: ground center at (256,384), LEFT ground vertex=(96,384), RIGHT=(416,384), FRONT=(256,464), REAR=(256,304). Draw each building on a thin flat natural stone or compacted-earth square platform following those four vertices EXACTLY. Every foundation is a SQUARE in world X/Y, not a long rectangle. Both visible ground-edge diagonals have equal length and slopes +0.5 and -0.5. Front/back vertices lie on the same vertical axis through the center. Left/right corners are at identical height. This is essential, the previous atlas had skewed rectangular bases and its buildings appeared rotated away from the game's grid.
Camera: TRUE symmetric 2:1 orthographic isometric looking directly along the diagonal between X and Y. Both visible building faces have equal projected orientation and width where the building footprint is square. All vertical columns/walls MUST remain perfectly vertical. No perspective convergence, asymmetric 3/4 oblique camera, Dutch angle, skewed foundation, sideways shifted front corner, rotated buildings or elongated platform.
Buildings centered on the same square ground foundation. Roman terracotta tiles pale stone red cloth, Mongol cream-felt yurt with blue cloth and timber, Persian limestone/adobe turquoise bands with age III columns/lion details, Tang curved dark tiles red timber and ivory panels, Ottoman terracotta/wood to stone arcades and teal domes. Age I modest, II more masonry and ornament, III rich monumental but compact. Keep recognizable existing designs. Place steps on one front-side edge inside the square platform, not protruding out of its bounds, and keep the literal FRONT corner of the platform clearly visible and centered. Decorative ornaments must stay inside platform/cell. Upper-left warm daylight, realistic grainy stone joints, roof tiles, felt folds, restrained contact shadow only. Keep small transparent gutters between all sprites. No people, landscape, trees, detached props, text, labels, watermark, guide lines, floating flags, or opaque backdrop. The geometry guide's crosshair/vertical strokes must not appear in final output. Final art must be richly detailed semi-realistic, not flat vector or plastic cartoon. Preserve true alpha background.
